answer: The “father of the father of computer science” is **Benjamin Babbage**—Charles Babbage’s father. Benjamin Babbage (1751‑1834) was an English banker and the partner in Praed’s & Co. of Fleet Street, and he raised the polymath who later created the first mechanical computer.
